title: Some local police have access to an ICE facial recognition app
script: Here is what viewers need to know right now. Reports are focusing on this development: Some local police have access to an ICE facial recognition app. In simple words, A document from the Department of Homeland Security outlines plans to issue local police facial recognition technology used by federal immigration agents, a move that will expand the scope of ICE surveillance Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update.
